name: GR00T N1.5
summary: An iteration on GR00T N1 that freezes the vision-language backbone during robot training to preserve grounding, improves the adapter between language and action, and folds in DreamGen: synthetic trajectories produced by video world models, teaching behaviors never demonstrated on hardware. Reported gains are largest in language following and few-shot adaptation to new embodiments.
innovation: Freezing the VLM during post-training so robot data does not erode semantic grounding.
Using video-world-model rollouts as a source of novel training trajectories.
matters: An early production example of world-model-generated data training a deployed policy.
limits: Incremental, and documented mostly through release notes rather than a standalone paper.
lineage: GR00T N1 with a frozen backbone and world-model-generated training data.
